note: Two-pillar score (council decision, Nov 2026). Every source is mapped onto the Metacritic scale (a*x+b); critics and players are combined separately, and the score is their midpoint. Refit with care: see pipeline/rating.py. Steam: % positive is first adjusted for review count (SteamDB's formula), then mapped (fitted Nov 2026 on 101 games with 500+ reviews); with 500+ reviews it counts as a full player source on its own. Steam with 500+ reviews is never set aside as an outlier.

counts.note: Count weighting (Nov 2026): a source's noise is s2/n on the Metacritic scale. Scores resting on fewer ratings than the typical game (n_ref, the median) are pulled toward mu; at or above n_ref nothing moves. Player sources are weighted by 1/(tau2 + s2/n). Steam's count is already handled by the SteamDB adjustment (s2 0).
